sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:6652
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 14469 of 2023

Applicant :- Raghuraj Khatana And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Daya Shanker Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri R.N. Srivastava, learned Aga for the State apprised the Court that he has received the
instructions, therefore, instant anticipatory bail application may be finally disposed off.
2. Heard Sri D.S. Pandey, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri R.N. Srivastava, learned AGA for the State.

3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 151 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad with a prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail during trial.

entities.text: Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ghaziabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicants and husband of the informant and according to the FIR applicants being family members of the husband of the informant tortured her for want of dowry.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicant no.1 is father-in-law of the informant,
applicant no.2 is her mother-in-law while applicant no.3 is her Devar and they never tortured the informant in any manner.
6.

He further submits that as punishment provided for all the offences is upto seven years, therefore,
during investigation after service of notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. without arrest charge-sheet has been filed against the applicants.
7. He further submits that applicants are not having any criminal history and they are having apprehension that if they will appear before the court concerned then they will be sent to jail.
8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicants.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. From the record, it reflects that applicant nos. 1, 2 and 3 are father-in-law, mother-in-law and Devar of the informant respectively and during investigation without any arrest charge-sheet has been filed and all the offences are punishable with maximum punishment of seven years and it appears to be a case of matrimonial dispute.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicants are entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till conclusion of trial.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: 14. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicants.

15. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
